title: Tram Engine — Production Health
description: Производственное здоровье движка: переобучение ML, ошибки предсказаний (p50/p90/p99, bias, профиль по часам), пайплайн инжеста и паблишинг в Convex (health_minute). Источник — /data/lab.db.

panels.title: Последний трейн ML (возраст)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (strftime('%s','now') - MAX(tsMin)*60)/3600.0 AS value FROM ml_train_log
targets.queryText: SELECT (strftime('%s','now') - MAX(tsMin)*60)/3600.0 AS value FROM ml_train_log

panels.description: Часов с последней записи в ml_train_log. Трейн ночной: > 26 ч — пропущен цикл, > 50 ч — два.

panels.title: Последний скор (возраст)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s','now') - MAX(atMs)/1000 AS value FROM scores
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%s','now') - MAX(atMs)/1000 AS value FROM scores

panels.description: Секунд с последней строки в scores. Ночью пары реже, но > 10 мин тишины — конвейер скоринга стоит.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT fixes AS value FROM rollup_ingest ORDER BY tsMin DESC LIMIT 1
targets.queryText: SELECT fixes AS value FROM rollup_ingest ORDER BY tsMin DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Publish failures (1 ч)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(publishFailures),0) AS value FROM health_minute WHERE atMs >= (strftime('%s','now')-3600)*1000
targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(publishFailures),0) AS value FROM health_minute WHERE atMs >= (strftime('%s','now')-3600)*1000

panels.description: Сумма неудачных Convex-пушей за час (health_minute). Любое ненулевое значение — смотреть логи tram-lab.

targets.queryText: SELECT bundleFleet AS value FROM health_minute ORDER BY atMs DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Holdout MAE gbdt

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT maeHoldout AS value FROM ml_train_log WHERE model='gbdt' ORDER BY tsMin DESC LIMIT 1
targets.queryText: SELECT maeHoldout AS value FROM ml_train_log WHERE model='gbdt' ORDER BY tsMin DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: MAE последнего трейна LightGBM на holdout. Исторический уровень ~54 м.

panels.title: Holdout MAE по моделям, м — история переобучений

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN model='gbdt' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN model='mlp' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "mlp", MAX(CASE WHEN model='naive_ds0' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "naive_ds0" FROM ml_train_log WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN model='gbdt' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN model='mlp' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "mlp", MAX(CASE WHEN model='naive_ds0' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "naive_ds0" FROM ml_train_log WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY time

panels.description: Каждая точка — один трейн (ночной цикл lab/ml/service.py). Рост gbdt между трейнами — деградация данных или фичей. Окно дашборда должно покрывать несколько суток, иначе точек мало.

panels.title: Размер обучающей выборки (nPairs)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(nPairs) AS "nPairs" FROM ml_train_log WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(nPairs) AS "nPairs" FROM ml_train_log WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY time

panels.description: Пары (фикс → следующий фикс) в последнем трейне. Должен монотонно расти с архивом; провал — обрезка/потеря данных.

panels.title: Последний трейн — все модели
panels.description: trainSeconds и feature importances в SQLite не пишутся (только в /data/models/report.json на томе lab-data) — здесь то, что есть в ml_train_log.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(tsMin*60,'unixepoch') AS "трейн (UTC)", model, nPairs, maeHoldout AS "MAE, м" FROM ml_train_log WHERE tsMin=(SELECT MAX(tsMin) FROM ml_train_log) ORDER BY maeHoldout
targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(tsMin*60,'unixepoch') AS "трейн (UTC)", model, nPairs, maeHoldout AS "MAE, м" FROM ml_train_log WHERE tsMin=(SELECT MAX(tsMin) FROM ml_train_log) ORDER BY maeHoldout

panels.title: p50 |ошибки|, м — по вариантам (10-мин корзины, взвешенно по n)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (tsMin/10)*600 AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "naive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-mode", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-smooth", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive-smooth' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive-smooth" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/10 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (tsMin/10)*600 AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "naive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-mode", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-smooth", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive-smooth' THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive-smooth" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/10 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Медиана абсолютной ошибки. ml-mode/ml-smooth — то, что РЕАЛЬНО отрисовывает телефон (published-цепь); ml-drive — shadow drive-v3; naive — пол, который обязаны бить все.

panels.title: p90 |ошибки|, м — по вариантам (10-мин корзины, взвешенно по n)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (tsMin/10)*600 AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "naive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-mode", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-smooth", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive-smooth' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive-smooth" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/10 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (tsMin/10)*600 AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "naive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-mode", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-smooth", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive-smooth' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive-smooth" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/10 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Хвост ошибки: жирные промахи. Синхронные пики всех вариантов сразу — это дефект фида, не модели (см. discarded в разделе пайплайна).

panels.title: p99 |ошибки|, м — из сырых scores (часовые корзины)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN absErrM END) AS "naive", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN absErrM END) AS "ml-gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN absErrM END) AS "ml-mode", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN absErrM END) AS "ml-drive" FROM (SELECT (atMs/3600000)*3600 AS time, variant, absErrM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atMs/3600000, variant ORDER BY absErrM) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY atMs/3600000, variant) AS cnt FROM scores WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND variant IN ('naive','ml-gbdt','ml-mode','ml-drive')) WHERE rn*100 >= cnt*99 AND (rn-1)*100 < cnt*99 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN absErrM END) AS "naive", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN absErrM END) AS "ml-gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN absErrM END) AS "ml-mode", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN absErrM END) AS "ml-drive" FROM (SELECT (atMs/3600000)*3600 AS time, variant, absErrM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atMs/3600000, variant ORDER BY absErrM) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY atMs/3600000, variant) AS cnt FROM scores WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND variant IN ('naive','ml-gbdt','ml-mode','ml-drive')) WHERE rn*100 >= cnt*99 AND (rn-1)*100 < cnt*99 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Точный p99 по сырым строкам scores (rollup хранит только p50/p90). ТЯЖЁЛЫЙ запрос: на окне 7д сканирует ~20 млн строк — держите окно ≤ 48 ч или ждите.

panels.title: Signed bias (mean errM), м — знак ошибки по вариантам

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (tsMin/10)*600 AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "naive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-mode", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-smooth", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/10 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (tsMin/10)*600 AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "naive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-mode", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-smooth' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-smooth", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/10 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Средняя ЗНАКОВАЯ ошибка: < 0 — модель отстаёт от трамвая, > 0 — забегает вперёд. naive всегда сильно < 0 (стоит на месте) — это ориентир масштаба.

panels.title: p90 |ошибки| по часам суток (Прага, UTC+2) — взвешенно, окно дашборда
panels.description: Профиль по времени суток: пики (7–9, 16–19) медленные и труднопредсказуемые, ночь быстрая. Час = локальный час Праги (фиксированный сдвиг +2, летнее время).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST((((tsMin*60)+7200)%86400)/3600 AS INTEGER) AS hour, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "naive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-mode", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST((((tsMin*60)+7200)%86400)/3600 AS INTEGER) AS hour, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "naive", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mode' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-mode", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN variant='ml-drive' THEN n END),0),1) AS "ml-drive" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

panels.title: p90 ml-mode по горизонту прогноза, м

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (tsMin/10)*600 AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='<30s' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='<30s' THEN n END),0),1) AS "<30s", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='30-60s' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='30-60s' THEN n END),0),1) AS "30-60s", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='60-120s' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='60-120s' THEN n END),0),1) AS "60-120s", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='120s+' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='120s+' THEN n END),0),1) AS "120s+" FROM rollup_minute WHERE variant='ml-mode' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/10 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (tsMin/10)*600 AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='<30s' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='<30s' THEN n END),0),1) AS "<30s", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='30-60s' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='30-60s' THEN n END),0),1) AS "30-60s", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='60-120s' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='60-120s' THEN n END),0),1) AS "60-120s", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='120s+' THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN hbucket='120s+' THEN n END),0),1) AS "120s+" FROM rollup_minute WHERE variant='ml-mode' AND tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/10 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Ошибка published-варианта как функция длины фикс-гэпа (горизонта): чем дольше молчит фид, тем дороже. Разъезжающийся 120s+ — деградация дальних предсказаний.

panels.title: Сводка точности: 24 ч vs 7 д (взвешенные перцентили, все варианты)
panels.description: p50/p90 из rollup_minute, взвешенно по n. Сравнение колонок 24ч и 7д показывает дрейф: сегодня хуже недели — что-то сломалось недавно.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT variant AS "вариант", SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "n 24ч", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN n END),0),1) AS "p50 24ч, м", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN n END),0),1) AS "p90 24ч, м", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN n END),0),1) AS "bias 24ч, м", SUM(n) AS "n 7д", ROUND(SUM(p50Abs*n)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(n),0),1) AS "p50 7д, м", ROUND(SUM(p90Abs*n)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(n),0),1) AS "p90 7д, м" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-604800)/60 GROUP BY variant ORDER BY 4
targets.queryText: SELECT variant AS "вариант", SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "n 24ч", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN p50Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN n END),0),1) AS "p50 24ч, м", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN p90Abs*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN n END),0),1) AS "p90 24ч, м", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN signedMean*n END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)/60 THEN n END),0),1) AS "bias 24ч, м", SUM(n) AS "n 7д", ROUND(SUM(p50Abs*n)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(n),0),1) AS "p50 7д, м", ROUND(SUM(p90Abs*n)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(n),0),1) AS "p90 7д, м" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin >= (strftime('%s','now')-604800)/60 GROUP BY variant ORDER BY 4

panels.title: Инжест: фиксы / батчи / discarded в минуту (5-мин корзины)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (tsMin/5)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(fixes),1) AS "фиксы/мин", ROUND(AVG(batches),1) AS "батчи/мин", ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(discarded,0)),2) AS "discarded/мин" FROM rollup_ingest WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/5 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (tsMin/5)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(fixes),1) AS "фиксы/мин", ROUND(AVG(batches),1) AS "батчи/мин", ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(discarded,0)),2) AS "discarded/мин" FROM rollup_ingest WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/5 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Поток данных из Convex. discarded — события > 22 м/с (сбросы одометрии фида), отсеянные гейтом скоринга; всплеск = шторм дефектов фида.

panels.title: Латентность фикс→движок и фикс-гэп, с (5-мин корзины)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (tsMin/5)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(avgLatencyS),1) AS "латентность фикс→движок", ROUND(AVG(avgFixGapS),1) AS "средний фикс-гэп" FROM rollup_ingest WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/5 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (tsMin/5)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(avgLatencyS),1) AS "латентность фикс→движок", ROUND(AVG(avgFixGapS),1) AS "средний фикс-гэп" FROM rollup_ingest WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/5 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Латентность — от observedAt фикса до батча в лаборатории (норма единицы секунд). Фикс-гэп — интервал между двумя настоящими фиксами машины (норма ~20–40 с, p90 ~79 с).

panels.title: Флот во времени

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (tsMin/5)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(vehicles),1) AS "флот (лаборатория)", ROUND(AVG(withGeometry),1) AS "с геометрией", ROUND(AVG(pollerFleetSize),1) AS "флот (поллер)" FROM rollup_ingest WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/5 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (tsMin/5)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(vehicles),1) AS "флот (лаборатория)", ROUND(AVG(withGeometry),1) AS "с геометрией", ROUND(AVG(pollerFleetSize),1) AS "флот (поллер)" FROM rollup_ingest WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/5 ORDER BY time

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/300000)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(bundleFleet),1) AS "флот (бандл)" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY atMs/300000 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/300000)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(bundleFleet),1) AS "флот (бандл)" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY atMs/300000 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Четыре взгляда на размер флота: поллер (источник), лаборатория (после инжеста), с геометрией (пригодны для физики), бандл (публикуется в Convex). Расходящиеся линии — где теряем машины.

panels.title: Геометрия: fetch ok / fail в минуту (5-мин корзины)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (tsMin/5)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(geomFetchOk),2) AS "geom ok/мин", ROUND(AVG(geomFetchFail),2) AS "geom fail/мин" FROM rollup_ingest WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/5 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (tsMin/5)*300 AS time, ROUND(AVG(geomFetchOk),2) AS "geom ok/мин", ROUND(AVG(geomFetchFail),2) AS "geom fail/мин" FROM rollup_ingest WHERE tsMin BETWEEN $__from/60000 AND $__to/60000 GROUP BY tsMin/5 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Загрузка геометрий трипов из Golemio. Постоянные fail — машины без оси s: не скорятся и не публикуются.

panels.title: ПАБЛИШИНГ И ЭМИССИИ (health_minute — дельты за минуту)
Convex push: pushes / heartbeats / failures в минуту

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, publishPushes AS "pushes", publishHeartbeats AS "heartbeats", publishFailures AS "failures" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, publishPushes AS "pushes", publishHeartbeats AS "heartbeats", publishFailures AS "failures" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time

panels.description: Публикация кривых в Convex (trajectories:publish). Heartbeats — пустые циклы (ночь — норма). Failures ≠ 0 — Convex недоступен или токен протух; телефоны едут на старых кривых.

panels.title: Vehicles pushed в минуту

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, vehiclesPushed AS "машин запушено" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, vehiclesPushed AS "машин запушено" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time

panels.description: Сколько обновлённых машин ушло в Convex за минуту. Должно ходить вместе с фиксами/мин; ноль при живом инжесте — паблишер молчит.

panels.title: Эмиссии: ml vs naive + доля naive

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, mlEmissions AS "ml-эмиссии", naiveEmissions AS "naive-эмиссии" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, mlEmissions AS "ml-эмиссии", naiveEmissions AS "naive-эмиссии" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, ROUND(naiveEmissions*100.0/NULLIF(naiveEmissions+mlEmissions,0),1) AS "доля naive, %" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, ROUND(naiveEmissions*100.0/NULLIF(naiveEmissions+mlEmissions,0),1) AS "доля naive, %" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time

panels.description: Двухфазная эмиссия: pass-1 naive (мгновенный ре-анкор) + pass-2 ML-апгрейд. Доля naive стабильно ~100% — ML-сервис не отвечает и флот живёт на учёной наивной физике.

panels.title: Fused axis: применений/мин и средняя поправка

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, fusedApplied AS "fused применён/мин", fusedMeanM AS "средняя поправка, м" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, fusedApplied AS "fused применён/мин", fusedMeanM AS "средняя поправка, м" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time

panels.description: Сколько фиксов в минуту переспроецировано по координатам (противоречие двух представлений фида) и на сколько метров в среднем. Резкий рост — фид снова врёт осью.

panels.title: Возраст данных: батч Convex, геометрия-пак, ML ready

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, convexBatchAgeS AS "возраст батча, с", packAgeS AS "возраст geometry-pack, с", mlReady AS "ML ready (0/1)" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, convexBatchAgeS AS "возраст батча, с", packAgeS AS "возраст geometry-pack, с", mlReady AS "ML ready (0/1)" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time

panels.description: Свежесть входов/выходов на момент минутного сэмпла. Пак обновляется раз в ~5 мин (возраст пилой до ~300 с — норма); батч старше 3 мин — стоит инжест.

panels.title: Publish failures — крупно

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, publishFailures AS "failures/мин" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/60000)*60 AS time, publishFailures AS "failures/мин" FROM health_minute WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time

panels.description: Та же метрика, что в светофоре, но во времени: когда именно Convex не принимал пуши.

panels.title: Симулятор-вотчер: аномалии восприятия / 10 мин (по классам)
panels.description: bench_anomalies из живого вотчера (tram-watch): оба режима рендера, детекторы полевых жалоб + контракт эмиссий. Ноль — цель; всплеск = класс вернулся, окно для реплея уже сохранено в /data/bench/windows.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/600000)*600 AS time, kind || ' (' || mode || ')' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM bench_anomalies WHERE atMs >= (strftime('%s','now')-86400)*1000 GROUP BY time, kind, mode ORDER BY time
